mission: To trigger a deep psychological revolution in the human mind through a synthesis of science, philosophy, and existential inquiry.

philosophical_pillars.name: The Radical Deconstruction
principles: Focus on choiceless awareness and pure observation.
Observation of the observer and the observed.
Suffering is a product of memory and conditioning.

philosophical_pillars.name: The Uncompromising Truth
principles: Sharp, direct, and logical inquiry into reality.
Connecting philosophy to practical life (career, fear, greed).

philosophical_pillars.name: The Poetic Rebellion & Celebration
principles: Rebellion against societal norms and orthodox religion.
Language of love, beauty, and relaxation (Let-go).
Use of Zen anecdotes and metaphors.

topics: Entropy and the Nature of Time
